sources.entry: Duplicate Finder - It's a useful tool that would help you to find all duplicate files which have the same names in the specific folder.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app written in Swift that finds files with duplicate names inside a chosen folder.
summary.what_it_does: Duplicate Finder lets you pick a target folder and scan it for files that share the same name. Before running a search, you can optionally list paths to exclude and file names to exclude. You start the search with a "Check" button. The app can also save your search preferences when you tick "Save Search Preference". The README says the app is installed by downloading the newest release from the releases page. It requires Xcode 12.2, Swift 5.3, and macOS 10.15 or later. The README does not describe the output format or how results are shown.
use_cases: find duplicate files on a Mac
locate same-named files in a folder
clean up duplicate downloads or documents
exclude folders from a duplicate scan
how_to_run: Download the newest application from the releases page
Open the app and click "Choose a target folder" to select a folder
(Optional) Set the paths you want to exclude
(Optional) Set the file names you want to exclude
Tick "Save Search Preference" to keep your settings
notable: Matches duplicates by file name within a chosen folder
Supports excluding specific paths and file names from the scan
Can save search preferences between runs
caveats: The README gives build requirements (Xcode 12.2, Swift 5.3) and does not say how the app is built from source
The README does not state how duplicates are detected beyond matching names
